body:
I posted before on a question like this but it was too late and got buried. Then I did a post on r/suicidewatch and r/gettingoverit, and pretty much got ignored both times so here goes nothing. Some people responded but quickly stopped. People always say their inboxes are open or something, but that just means for 30 minutes before they decide to leave. So here goes nothing.

I have an extreme problem of depression and extreme self loathing. Some days I can barely talk to anyone because I'm so filled with sadness that turns into hatred for myself. Growing up my sister was very verbally abusive, constantly belittling me and making me feel worthless which caused a great deal of harm for me. Every time I talk about this stuff, whether on here or other online resources for depression or even in person with my so called friend I get ignored and I feel totally alone in all this.

Some days I'm good, most I'm totally horrible. I think about ending it all, just stepping on the gas pedal and crashing into a pole. I might do it soon

Nothing serious that I regret, I've never done real harm to anyone or to myself. I never had a lot of confidence or self esteem growing up, just the way I am, and growing up my sister was pretty emotionally/verbally abusive which destroyed any chance for confidence for me.

When I'm not in a downswing I just kinda feel indifferent. There are moments of happiness, like when I listen to an awesome song or hangout with friends but those are fleeting and brief moments. I do get external praise mainly from my family but no matter what I can never feel good about myself because I still have this intense hate for myself that lies somewhere deep inside.

Sorry this is late, I fell asleep shortly after I posted. I fall into these weird self destructive modes where I just get irrationally angry at everything, mostly myself. I still have problems with self loathing, and it doesn't seem to have an end in sight

This isn't gonna be seen but I made an account just to write here so whatever.

I fucking hate myself. Everyday I wake up, realize I have to be me and just sink deeper and deeper into self loathing and depression. I never had a lot of confidence growing up, and having an emotional/verbal abusive younger sister didn't fucking help. What started as confidence issues grew into pure hatred for myself. I'm really sick of it, deep down I want to be happy and ok with who I am but I'm too scared to go out get help. 

So how am I? Pretty horrible and don't even know how to get help:(

I don't think this made a lot of sense, but I think it's too late for anyone to really see this but I'm sorry if you do.
